about_the_game:
MEET LUCRETIA!

Age: 27 years old

Zodiac Sign: Cancer

Preferences: Ancient Freeman sexual rituals, sex in dangerous places, orgies.

Legendary treasure hunter Lucretia has amassed a remarkable collection of relics, including an array of sexual toys, yet she's never satisfied. Always on the move, she travels extensively, solving one mystery after another. Lucretia collects not just ancient artifacts but lovers too — finding another person is as intriguing to her as deciphering an ancient riddle.

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

From now on, Lucretia will not only be your reliable companion but also your inspiring muse! She will always accompany you on the main screen with her dynamic animations and captivating dialogues.

By purchasing this DLC, you get the Lucretia mascot! You can switch your mascot at any time by opening your profile and selecting the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you're getting 5000 credits and 150 super serum.

But most importantly, you're getting our undying gratitude! Thank you for considering purchasing this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
